summary:
Held 1 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — WKL.AS +10%, UNA.AS +7%, SAP.DE +7%, G24.DE +6%, CAP.PA +6%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 3 downside moves (BESI.AS -9%, PHIA.AS -9%, ASM.AS -5%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: WKL.AS (+9.57%) — No fresh same-day news found; move extends a multi-day rally from JPMorgan's early-July Overweight upgrade (PT €87) and circulating LBO/take-private speculation (17% IRR at 30% premium). Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe — WKL.AS is a Euronext Amsterdam-listed Dutch info-services/software mid-cap (~$15B); the uk-eu universe likely scopes to LSE-primary listings and excludes this exchange/sector combination.
